ideas.title: Thin vertical slice: abstract → 20 s mp4 on the free path (extractive script, Kokoro, synth music, captions)
ideas.why: Proves every layer end to end before widening

ideas.title: Versioned zod schema as the single contract (Source → Segments → Ideas → Script → Timeline → Render)
ideas.why: Every layer validates against one schema; the web app shares the types

ideas.title: Job queue: one render at a time, resumable stages, cached artifacts per stage
ideas.why: Rule: one render at a time; re-rendering after a script edit skips analysis

ideas.title: Content-addressed stage cache (hash of input + settings + model id)
ideas.why: Fast re-renders; deterministic tests

ideas.title: PDF ingestion with pdfjs: text with page/position, headings, captions, reading order (2-column)
ideas.why: Papers are the flagship input

ideas.title: Figure cropping from PDFs: embedded raster images via operator list + caption-anchored region crops for vector figures
ideas.why: Real figures from the paper are the most trusted visual

ideas.title: Images input: OCR (tesseract.js) for text in screenshots/slides, captions from the user, optional vision model
ideas.why: Image sets must work with zero keys

ideas.title: Projects: folder, zip, GitHub URL (codeload tarball), README; file tree + manifests + entry points + key code
ideas.why: “Explain this repo in 60 s” is a killer use for new engineers

ideas.title: arXiv URL → fetch the PDF directly (public)
ideas.why: Most papers users want are on arXiv

ideas.title: Web article URL → readability extraction
ideas.why: Blogs and docs pages; careful with robots/ToS

ideas.title: Table extraction from PDFs → chart data
ideas.why: Charts that build from the paper’s own numbers

ideas.title: Extractive floor: TextRank + position/abstract/number heuristics, zero model
ideas.why: Works instantly with no download; faithful by construction; deterministic tests

ideas.title: LLM key-idea extraction with segment citations and verbatim evidence quotes, verified against the source
ideas.why: Traceability: every idea maps back to where it came from

ideas.title: Map-reduce over long sources (chunk → ideas → merge/dedupe → rank) to fit a 4B model’s context
ideas.why: 10-page papers are ~10k tokens

ideas.title: Importance ranking that blends model scores with structure (title, abstract, conclusion, repetition, has-number)
ideas.why: Stabilises a small model’s noisy rankings

ideas.title: Length budget: words/s per mode, beats and ideas per length, ±10% fit loop
ideas.why: The core promise: you click 20 s, you get 20 s

ideas.title: Beat-structured script: hook → ideas (one per beat) → takeaway, each beat with a typed visual
ideas.why: One idea per beat; visuals chosen from a fixed library the renderer can draw

ideas.title: Plain-words pass: reading-level and jargon checks; define a term the first time it is said
ideas.why: Teaching first

ideas.title: Duration fit after TTS: measure real audio, then tighten text or nudge voice speed (0.9–1.15×) to land within ±10%
ideas.why: Word-count estimates drift; real audio is ground truth

ideas.title: Analogy beat (“it’s like…”) only when the model marks it as an analogy, not a claim
ideas.why: Analogies help understanding but must not be presented as source claims

ideas.title: Deterministic claim checks: every number, name and quoted term in narration must appear in the cited segments
ideas.why: Cheap, exact, catches the most dangerous hallucinations

ideas.title: Entailment judge per claim (local model or BYOK), drop/rewrite unsupported beats
ideas.why: Zero unsupported claims is a stop criterion

ideas.title: Source map output: claim → segment → page/line, shown in the app next to the video
ideas.why: Trust: users can check every sentence

ideas.title: Design system: 1 background family, 5 semantic colours + neutrals, type scale, motion tokens, shared by app and video
ideas.why: Consistency is what makes it look designed

ideas.title: Scene library v1: title, keyword highlight, big number, bullet build, bar chart, flow diagram, quote, code typing, figure, takeaway
ideas.why: Every beat has motion

ideas.title: Golden-frame tests for every scene at fixed t (pixel diff with tolerance)
ideas.why: Renderer regressions caught by CI

ideas.title: Live browser preview drawing the same scenes on a <canvas> before the mp4 renders
ideas.why: Instant feedback; the core is pure so it runs in both

ideas.title: Kinetic typography: the spoken keyword pops in sync with the voice (word timings)
ideas.why: Dual coding + signaling

ideas.title: Ken Burns + highlight box on cropped paper figures
ideas.why: Draws the eye to the part of the figure that matters

ideas.title: Animated diagrams from model-emitted graph JSON (nodes/edges, auto-layout)
ideas.why: Architectures and pipelines are the heart of papers and projects

ideas.title: Code that types itself with syntax colours and a highlight sweep on the key line
ideas.why: Projects input

ideas.title: Optional AI-generated images on a provider key (OpenAI images), never on the free path
ideas.why: Hard rule: optional only

ideas.title: Particle/confetti background textures
ideas.why: Decoration without meaning violates the coherence principle; adds render cost

ideas.title: 3D scenes (three.js) for architecture explainers
ideas.why: Huge cost, weak teaching gain over clean 2D; revisit never

ideas.title: Music bed synthesized in code: pads, bass, plucks; mood + tempo per length; deterministic per seed
ideas.why: No samples, no licences, works offline

ideas.title: SFX synthesized: whoosh on transitions, pop on keyword, tick on number count-up, soft riser into the takeaway
ideas.why: Sound on transitions is in the brief

ideas.title: Sidechain ducking of music under the voice + loudness normalisation to −16 LUFS / −1 dBTP
ideas.why: Voice must always be clear

ideas.title: CC0 sample libraries for music
ideas.why: Licence tracking and download size; code synthesis is good enough and fully offline

ideas.title: Kokoro-82M local narration (kokoro-js fp32, RTF ~0.26 on M4 Pro) with a voice picker
ideas.why: Measured: whisper transcribed it verbatim

ideas.title: System voice fallback (say / SAPI / espeak-ng) when Kokoro is not downloaded
ideas.why: Never fail to produce audio

ideas.title: Word timings: proportional by syllables per sentence, refined by whisper alignment when available
ideas.why: Captions and keyword pops must be in sync

ideas.title: ElevenLabs + OpenAI TTS voices on BYOK
ideas.why: Better voices for those who have keys

ideas.title: Voice cloning of the user
ideas.why: Consent/abuse risk and not needed for teaching

ideas.title: Local LLM via node-llama-cpp (in-process, prebuilt mac/win/linux) with JSON-schema grammars
ideas.why: One command on any machine; structured output that never fails to parse

ideas.title: Model manager: download with free-disk check, size budget (≤8 GB), checksum, resume, link an existing GGUF
ideas.why: Hard rule on disk

ideas.title: Model router: per task (analyze, script, judge) with fallback chain local → BYOK → extractive floor
ideas.why: Reuse LachedInAI’s ModelRouter idea

ideas.title: Fine-tune a small open model (LoRA) on great script examples
ideas.why: Only after the eval set shows where the 4B model loses; plan in BUILD_AN_AI.md

ideas.title: Keystore: OS keychain (@napi-rs/keyring) with a 0600-file fallback; masked reads only
ideas.why: Keys never leave the machine except to their provider

ideas.title: OpenRouter OAuth PKCE “link your account” on a 127.0.0.1 callback
ideas.why: The brief asks for account linking

ideas.title: Provider clients: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini, OpenRouter, ElevenLabs with host pinning
ideas.why: Keys are sent only to their own host

ideas.title: Hugging Face OAuth sign-in (needs an OAuth app client id)
ideas.why: Real OAuth with free inference credits; blocked on a client id from the owner
notes: 2026-11-04 needs a Hugging Face OAuth app client id from the owner

ideas.title: Cost estimate before a BYOK render
ideas.why: No surprise bills

ideas.title: Input screen: paste / PDF / images / project / URL, with the confidentiality note
ideas.why: Hard rule

ideas.title: Ideas review step: show ranked key ideas with sources; user can pin/drop before rendering
ideas.why: Human in the loop for teaching

ideas.title: Length picker 20 s / 1 min / 3 min / 5 min / custom with a preview of how many ideas fit
ideas.why: Core promise made visible

ideas.title: Watch page: player, captions toggle, script with timestamps, source map, downloads (mp4, vtt, script, sourcemap)
ideas.why: Output requirements

ideas.title: Script editor: edit a beat’s words and re-render only audio+frames
ideas.why: Fix what the AI got wrong

ideas.title: Library of past videos
ideas.why: Find old videos

ideas.title: Electron desktop wrapper
ideas.why: A localhost web app already works on every OS; Electron adds 150 MB and signing

ideas.title: Eval set: 15+ public sources with hand-written key points + questions
ideas.why: Stop criterion

ideas.title: Metrics: faithfulness (0 unsupported), coverage for length, understanding (fresh model answers from script + on-screen text)
ideas.why: Stop criterion

ideas.title: Regression gate: evals must not drop when prompts/models change
ideas.why: Same rule as LachedInAI

ideas.title: make setup / check / doctor / dev / video / frames / evals / e2e
ideas.why: One-command everything

ideas.title: Doctor: disk, models, ffmpeg (system or ffmpeg-static), fonts, keys, ports, node version, with exact fix commands
ideas.why: Self-healing checks

ideas.title: Temp-render cleanup + artifact retention
ideas.why: Disk rule

ideas.title: GitHub Actions CI (lint/test on mac/win/linux)
ideas.why: Proves cross-platform; owner pushes

ideas.title: Public website path: static front end + per-user BYOK in the browser, render on the user’s machine or a queue (FUTURE)
ideas.why: Documented in STATUS; not this version

ideas.title: Docker image for one-command self-hosting
ideas.why: Later; npm is enough now

ideas.title: Captions burned in + soft subtitle track + VTT/SRT downloads
ideas.why: Accessibility and silent viewing

ideas.title: Colour-blind-safe palette, contrast ≥ 4.5:1 for all on-screen text
ideas.why: Colour is never the only signal

ideas.title: Audio description track
ideas.why: Interesting, low priority

ideas.title: Quiz card at the end (one retrieval question) for 1 min+
ideas.why: Retrieval practice from MasterDoc research; optional so it doesn’t eat the budget

ideas.title: “Explain like I’m new” vs “expert” level toggle
ideas.why: Same source, different audiences
notes: 2026-11-04 level select in UI + prompt LEVEL_TEXT

ideas.title: Chapters for 3–5 min videos
ideas.why: Navigation

ideas.title: Talking-head avatar presenter
ideas.why: Uncanny, costly, distracts from the content (coherence principle)

ideas.title: Background stock footage
ideas.why: Decorative, licence-heavy, not tied to the source

ideas.title: Cloud rendering farm
ideas.why: Contradicts local-first and free
